class.name: VisionOSHoverStyle2D
class.brief_description: Shape settings for a native visionOS 2D hover target.
class.description: Assign this resource to [UIKitHoverEffect2D.style]. It selects the system effect and shape, and controls whether the target appears.

members.member: Whether the hover target is visible.
Corner radius in Godot pixels when [member shape] is StyleBox. A negative value uses the Control's normal StyleBoxFlat radius, when available.
System effect: Highlight, Automatic, or Lift. UIKit may fall back when an effect is unavailable for a layer.
Target shape: StyleBox rounded rectangle, rectangle, capsule, or circle.
